5 ترشّح : see 1, first sentence. ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) He (a young weaned camel) was, or became, strong enough to walk, or able to walk with strength: (S, K:) or became strong, and walked with his mother. (As, S.) [See 1.] ―
-b3- See also 2, in the middle of the paragraph. ―
-b4- ترشّح النَّبْتُ [or النَّبَاتُ] (assumed tropical:) The herbage became fostered by moisture or dew. (Msb.) ―
-b5- ترشّح فُلَانٌ لِكَذَا: see 2, near the end of the paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
